paragraphs.zh: Mittels nach Anspruch 8 oder 9 auf die Pflanzen oder auf den Ort des unerwünschten Pflanzenwachstums appliziert.
paragraphs.en: composition according to Claim 8 or 9 is applied to the plants or to the locus of undesired plant growth.
paragraphs.notes: Closing lines of claim 10, which began on the preceding page; no claim number is printed here and the text is not indented. 'Mittels' is the genitive of 'Mittel' governed by a phrase that ended on the previous page, so the English is a sentence fragment too. The word is rendered 'composition' to match 'herbizide Mittel' elsewhere in the claim set.

paragraphs.zh: 11.     Verwendung von Verbindungen der allgemeinen Formel (I) nach einem der Ansprüche 1 bis 7 oder von herbiziden Mitteln nach Anspruch 8 oder 9 zur Bekämpfung unerwünschter Pflanzen.
paragraphs.en: 11.     Use of compounds of the general formula (I) according to any one of Claims 1 to 7, or of herbicidal compositions according to Claim 8 or 9, for controlling undesired plants.
paragraphs.notes: A small stray ink squiggle sits above the line, between 'Formel (I)' and 'nach'. It is a scan artifact, not a character or a footnote reference.

paragraphs.zh: 12.     Verwendung nach Anspruch 11, dadurch gekennzeichnet, daß die Verbindungen der allgemeinen Formel (I) zur Bekämpfung unerwünschter Pflanzen in Kulturen von Nutzpflanzen eingesetzt werden.
paragraphs.en: 12.     Use according to Claim 11, characterized in that the compounds of the general formula (I) are employed for controlling undesired plants in crops of useful plants.
paragraphs.notes: The eszett in 'daß' is as printed (pre-1996 orthography, used throughout this document). The Roman numeral in '(I)' is printed with a partly broken serif and reads at a glance like a lower-case l; it is the same formula label (I) used in claims 1 to 11 and is transcribed as capital I.

paragraphs.zh: 13.     Verwendung nach Anspruch 12, dadurch gekennzeichnet, daß die Nutzpflanzen transgene Nutzpflanzen sind.
paragraphs.en: 13.     Use according to Claim 12, characterized in that the useful plants are transgenic useful plants.
paragraphs.notes: Last claim of the patent. The lower two thirds of the page is blank, so the Patentansprueche end here.
